summary: Truist Financial Corp filed a Form 8-K to report the issuance and sale of $2B aggregate principal amount of senior medium-term notes under an existing shelf registration statement. The offering comprised $1B of 4.680% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due 2032 and $1B of 5.281% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due 2037. The transaction is a routine debt capital markets take-down by the registrant, not a special situation.
